title: Affine restriction and uniform inner product
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{R}$, let $H$ be a linear subspace of $\mathbb{F}_2^n$, and let $z\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. The uniform average of $f(h+z)$ over $h\in H$ equals the uniform inner product of the density of $H$ with the function $x\mapsto f(x+z)$ on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$.
